name: Kieran
source:
Kieran used to be a kind, gentle soul who always liked to laugh. He/She was also a very spirited child in his/her youth. In Book 1, however, Kieran feels little emotion and is considered to be a cold, broken shadow of what he/she once was. Over the years, the more family Kieran lost, the more bitter he/she became. Kieran spent decades alone, crafting defenses around him/herself, not allowing anyone close enough to hurt him/her. When he/she fell in love and that love betrayed him/her, that love shattered Kieran's heart both literally and figuratively, cursing Kieran to become the Winged Beast every night fall.

Cursed or not, Kieran has a protective side, like when he/she saved MC from a wolf in the forest or an arrow in the Royal Hunt. He/she also flirts with you shamelessly, to the point of telling you that you get flustered so easily that it was hard not to tease you. He/She's not exactly shy either, proving it when he/she tells you that if you wanted to see him/her unclothed you just had to ask or when he/she swims with you and the Sun Court Fae in the river after the Royal Hunt.
